subject: Re: SIG follow-up — data retention, prompts, and training on customer data
messages:
From: Paolo Rossi <paolo.rossi@acme-corp.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: amanda.carter@stratusai.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: SIG follow-up — data handling clarifications

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for submitting the SIG. Our procurement security team reviewed sections related to data lifecycle and model training and flagged a few clarifications we need before we proceed: 

1) Retention: what is the default retention period for "prompt logs" (requests and responses) on Redwood's hosted API? Is there an option for customers to set shorter retention?
2) Training: do you ever use customer prompts or outputs to train Redwood models (or any models hosted by Redwood) absent explicit customer consent? If so, how is consent captured and scoped?
3) Redaction & tooling: do you provide built-in redaction or PII masking prior to storage, or example tools we can run client-side?
4) Contract language: procurement wants a short statement we can include in our SOW/DPA that guarantees customer data is not used for model training unless explicitly agreed.

Can you respond with brief answers and point us to any artifacts (SOC 2 report, SIG evidence, data flow diagram) we can attach to our internal approval? Ideally we need this by Monday 1/19.

Thanks,
Paolo
Security Program Manager — Acme Corp

--
Acme Contract Reference: ACME-1294

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Paolo Rossi <paolo.rossi@acme-corp.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 08:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — data handling clarifications

Paolo — thanks for the clear list. Answers below are condensed for procurement; attaching a slightly expanded SIG evidence pack and our recent SOC 2 report.

1) Retention: Hosted API (default) — prompt/request logs and standard inference telemetry are retained for 90 days by default. Customers on Hosted can request shorter retention windows via support (minimum 7 days). Dedicated and Private deployments: retention is configurable by the customer; Redwood does not enforce retention policies for customer-managed deployments.

2) Training: Redwood does NOT train or incorporate customer prompts/outputs into any model training corpus by default. We only use customer data for model improvement when a customer explicitly opts in via a documented agreement (typically a checkbox in the Console and an accompanying contractual amendment). We maintain an internal "do_not_train" flag at the tenant level to ensure data excluded from training is never surfaced to training pipelines.

3) Redaction & tooling: We provide a client-side redaction example (attached: redaction_script_example.py) and guidance in our docs. Additionally, Console integrations let customers mask PII before storage; for Hosted customers we can enable automated token-level masking on ingest on request.

4) Contract language: see short statement below that you can paste into the DPA/SOW: 

"Redwood Inference will not use Customer Data (including prompts, logs, or outputs) to improve, fine-tune, or train any machine learning models unless Customer provides explicit, documented consent. Customer may require Redwood to enable a tenant-level "do_not_train" setting which will prevent Customer Data from being ingested into any training pipelines."

Evidence & artifacts: attached SOC 2 report (SOC2_report_Redwood_2025.pdf), completed SIG answers summary (redwood_sig_answers_v1.pdf), and a data flow diagram mapping (redwood-data-flow-acme.png). Also linking our DPA page: https://app.redwood.ai/dpa/ACME-1294

If you want a short one-paragraph vendor attestation for your procurement summary, I can send that too.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): redwood_sig_answers_v1.pdf, SOC2_report_Redwood_2025.pdf, redwood-data-flow-acme.png, redaction_script_example.py

Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up — data handling clarifications

Paolo — quick clarifications to your two bullets: 

- Deletion SLA: For Hosted customers who request a shorter retention or an immediate purge, we provide a deletion window commitment of 72 hours from a validated request (support ticket + authenticated account owner). For Dedicated/Private, the customer controls deletion and Redwood will assist per the operational support plan.

- Retroactive effect of do_not_train flag: Yes. When a tenant enables the do_not_train flag (either via Console toggle for self-serve or via contract and Support request), the flag prevents both future ingestion into training pipelines and marks existing Stored Prompt Logs in the hosted retention store as excluded from any training pipelines. We maintain an auditable export showing the exclusion date and scope; sample export is included in the SIG evidence pack.

I'll ask Legal to produce a succinct vendor attestation paragraph as well — looping in Monica for a quick review of the DPA wording.

Thanks,
Karthik

Paolo / Karthik — I reviewed the proposed DPA language and the summary above. Procurement-friendly attestation you can include in your vendor pack: 

"Vendor attestation: Redwood Inference confirms that Customer Data (including prompts, responses, and request metadata) will not be used to train or improve any models unless Customer provides explicit, written consent. Upon Customer request, Redwood will enable the tenant-level do_not_train control which will (a) prevent future use of Customer Data in training pipelines and (b) mark existing stored data as excluded from training. For Hosted customers, Redwood will honor deletion requests and complete data purge operations within 72 hours of a validated request. Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report and additional SIG artifacts are provided for review."

If you need this on Redwood letterhead, we can produce a short signed attestation PDF.

-Monica
